name: Parity Harness
description: How one RenderBackend is measured against another (Sources/CoreRender/Parity): ParityTolerance (byte and linear bounds, .standard and .nonSeparable); ParityHarness.compare, which checks two results' sRGB display bytes through CoreRaster's rgba8 and their linear premultiplied Floats over visible pixels and names the worst pixel; ParityHarness.compare(golden:), the bytes-only compare of a result against a golden, encoded in the golden's color space (both compares count only alpha where both alpha bytes are 0); ParityPack, the layout of the packed CPU goldens (ParityPack.all, each sample's band of rows) and ParityGolden.band(from:op:sample:) and rows(_:), which copy one sample's golden out of its pack; the deterministic sample set per RenderOp (seeded buffers plus alpha 0, subnormal alpha, opaque rows and sources off every edge) and rendering a sample on any backend, with one Samples+<Family>.swift file per W1 family (masked composite, affine, effect, color) giving that family's samples and packs, empty until its feature fills them (affine's ten samples through transformed, flipped and the composite through a matrix are in, one 9-wide pack; effect's twelve samples through applying, every LayerEffect case and a three-effect stack applied in turn, are in, one 9-wide pack; color's 44, one per colour ToneAdjustment case, LUT included, on each of the four 9x7 edge-case sources, one .standard pack); and golden files (raw rgba8 bytes beside a JSON header), validated as untrusted input.
